purpose: Persistent engineering notebook/checkpoint index so reconstruction decisions are not lost across long contexts.

mission.canonical_summary_ru: ADV_Elite — автономный и переносной узел JANUS, одновременно являющийся частью умного дома. Он общается со swarm двусторонне, учится на реальных метриках физических датчиков и логах swarm, строит прогноз следующего состояния окружения и должен со временем уменьшать ошибку прогноза.
mission.strict_interpretation: Упорядочивание хаоса означает снижение проверяемой ошибки предсказания на будущих реальных данных; метафора не является физическим или научным утверждением сама по себе.

predictive_ai_contract.success_definition: Улучшение считается реальным только если на отложенных будущих наблюдениях ошибка модели устойчиво ниже заранее зафиксированного baseline и преимущество повторяется на нескольких сессиях.

m2r_definition.origin: Calculator-style mathematical kernel repurposed as a generic forward simulator/world model, not as a weapon-control path.

janus_tachyon_semantics.tachyon: JANUS architecture/persona metaphor for a system that tries to stay ahead of observed state by forecasting future states.
janus_tachyon_semantics.atomic_clock: Authoritative disciplined time axis aligning observation, prediction horizon, realized future, replay, and prediction error.
janus_tachyon_semantics.epistemic_guard: No literal faster-than-light behavior or physical time-dilation claim follows from the Tachyon metaphor.

input: real current and historical sensor state
known deterministic or empirical physical relations
feedback: wait for matching real future timestamp
persist prediction and outcome in Witness

relationship_to_ai.predictive_ai: learned residual model, fusion layer, scenario scorer and pattern learner
relationship_to_ai.tachyon: temporal prediction/memory layer using the authoritative time axis
relationship_to_ai.witness: records what was predicted, when, from which inputs/model version, and what actually happened

compute_strategy.edge: bounded ensembles or reduced-order simulation on ESP32-class hardware
compute_strategy.habitat: heavier Monte Carlo/replay/calibration/model fitting on NAS/PC
compute_strategy.note: Future-cloud size is profiled and budgeted; no unverified throughput number is treated as fact.

adaptive_temporal_resolution.role: Sampling density and horizon may adapt to uncertainty/error, but this is subordinate to M2R's world-model role.

tachyon_1488_definition.user_intent: Entering 1488 activates M2R so JANUS begins forecasting the future and producing simulations specifically to improve future prediction.
active_after_1488: produce predictions for one or more horizons
timestamp forecast against authoritative time axis
compare predicted state with later real observations

forecast_scope_definition.user_intent: JANUS should try to predict literally everything available to it, including its own future internal state. M2R exists to give JANUS navigation from accumulated past toward possible futures.

self_model_requirement.reason: A predictor that models the environment but not its own changing state misses a causal component of the system it is embedded in.

temporal_navigation.name: PAST_TO_FUTURE_NAVIGATION
temporal_navigation.later_ground_truth: real observations arriving at the predicted timestamps
temporal_navigation.learning_loop: forecast -> wait -> observe -> score -> update -> preserve

causality_guard.implementation_statement: The system predicts forward from prior/current data. Humans or other external observers may later know what actually happened, but JANUS does not receive that future information before it occurs.
causality_guard.metaphor: The user framing 'we are already ahead of JANUS' is preserved as an observer-position metaphor: future observations become JANUS's later ground truth.

dirac_belt_metaphor.janus_meaning: M2R is treated as a continuity/path-memory bridge that keeps orientation between past state, simulated future paths, and the later realized state.
dirac_belt_metaphor.physics_guard: The actual Dirac belt/plate trick concerns topology of rotations/spinor behavior and is not evidence for causal inversion or information arriving from the future.

practical_constraint.everything_means: everything JANUS can observe, derive, or model under explicit schemas and uncertainty budgets, not an unbounded claim to predict the entire universe
practical_constraint.unknown_state: must remain UNKNOWN rather than fabricated
